LanguageData.BF_CommandDesc: Arrange the selected drafted colonists in a battle formation.
LanguageData.BF_PlaceHint: Click: place Drag: draw the front line Q/E: turn Right-click: cancel
LanguageData.BF_HoldDesc: The group becomes a regiment. A normal right-click move order then marches the whole regiment in formation.
LanguageData.BF_RegimentTip: Click: select (again: jump to) Right-click: options Key:
LanguageData.BF_Info: History and background of this formation
LanguageData.BF_Tactic_HoldDesc: stands its ground. Fighters pushed out of place walk back to their slot once no enemy is close.
LanguageData.BF_Tactic_ReliefDesc: wounded fighters in the front rank swap places with healthy ones from the rear lines.
LanguageData.BF_Tactic_ChargeDesc: when enemies come within 12 cells, all melee fighters charge the nearest enemy, then return to the formation.
LanguageData.BF_Tactic_WingChargeDesc: when enemies come within 12 cells, only the melee fighters of the left wing charge; the right wing holds back.
LanguageData.BF_Tactic_EnvelopDesc: when enemies come within 12 cells, the center holds while the melee fighters on both outer wings charge and close in.
LanguageData.BF_Tactic_SkirmishDesc: ranged fighters fall back when a melee enemy comes within 5 cells, and return to the line later.
LanguageData.BF_Tactic_AmbushDesc: everyone holds fire until an enemy comes within 14 cells or someone is hit, then all open fire at once. Switching fire at will on for one member springs it too.
